reuse.why: Introduces getFillableCategories and routes setZero, set3MonthAvg, set6MonthAvg, set12MonthAvg and the new setLastMonthSpending through it, replacing the per-action SQL copies; copyPreviousMonth reuses the template and #fixed set helpers but not the selection itself.

duplication.why: copyPreviousMonth re-states the full exclusion rule inline (hidden/group_hidden unless includeHiddenCategories, templated, fixed, income outside tracking), duplicating what getFillableCategories decides for the other actions.

placement.why: Selection helpers and actions live together in budget/actions.ts and the new method is registered in budget/app.ts, matching the tree's layering.

scope.why: Focused on the four requested behaviours; the reshaping of set6/set12 into setAllCategoriesNMonthAvg and of set3MonthAvg's signature is consolidation in service of them.

maintainability.why: Mostly one selection function, but the rule set lives in two places (getFillableCategories and copyPreviousMonth), set3MonthAvg keeps its own loop instead of the shared N-month helper, and the hidden filter is a conditional SQL string fragment.

bypasses_abstraction.where: actions.ts copyPreviousMonth applies the hidden/templated/fixed/income exclusions itself instead of using getFillableCategories

abstraction_drift.where: getFillableCategories gains the includeHiddenCategories flag (conditional SQL fragment); copyPreviousMonth carries its own copy of the exclusion rules, threading the same flag separately
